Mixing aspirin and alcohol ` [Highlight start] increases the risk of stomach irritation, ulcers, and gastrointestinal bleeding [Highlight end] ` . Both substances irritate the stomach lining, and aspirin also reduces blood clotting, making any bleeding more serious.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAIoWS0uPPNDYmh4qGvKoVscbU8TlQGdrmzLPqYeht49bY-_q3tpLIkWLQAgbse1Qci5H2mZ9XidKN4x6TgmlALCA27rgmn_cKe8wYyKDLZrhGtDQ7MIqLRGmJGkUUgBTTy0pjq063w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXhn6zq4ivRsGWIPLJ8DX32FqyGitx6YKfNnBcJBs-kdfbI6MRwro0JP2qwtVOBL-eb3jS4oXWzVc09GMApw9to3_pcc5RO0Pq_xWnBipqsQi-5_FcOGjsdz2tkj1cDNqijVvg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXd1fyr644D-gW6x5BgFe8rxHT_OQukA1fRiLUkajcasB2bwb9SMYS1uG6DqGs13h7huKYlVycrFSsip-Ynyw8vEgaVA9kdmgwHP8AgbfIgv7f429xCwEg4PI4vyiimvIu_ksM8H2rcULqaj6eU1kf7kELiIWqhj8)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXN7eHtIZJXdKXfYVG2CFZ3Kp7mIHJ-US8zmLFuh6lOmFyjviLyf1lC8mssSe5AyIju8s54TwgPD2euIhsJDp892o13NHaNqsCz0_Z5BamLtrkQZzMWFlzbFeov_RMj6P9HGH_JmLE)

### Key Risks

- **Stomach upset and ulcers:** Nausea, heartburn, vomiting, and damage to the stomach lining can occur even with low-dose ("baby") aspirin.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXhn6zq4ivRsGWIPLJ8DX32FqyGitx6YKfNnBcJBs-kdfbI6MRwro0JP2qwtVOBL-eb3jS4oXWzVc09GMApw9to3_pcc5RO0Pq_xWnBipqsQi-5_FcOGjsdz2tkj1cDNqijVvg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAIoWS0uPPNDYmh4qGvKoVscbU8TlQGdrmzLPqYeht49bY-_q3tpLIkWLQAgbse1Qci5H2mZ9XidKN4x6TgmlALCA27rgmn_cKe8wYyKDLZrhGtDQ7MIqLRGmJGkUUgBTTy0pjq063w)
- **Gastrointestinal bleeding:** Heavy or frequent drinking combined with regular aspirin use significantly raises the risk of bleeding in the stomach or intestines.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF10i5iLO5CJowKqsx9L4Gv3RvSQhjxIo-kY7jyWnCIQxCSeDKoYZUWVYBvfhLp8ASNRabdIXQoWnWCGoHN3sOlHQla2NiAjfdm7N6JWcvfS7ptK0yF3nJTyTn7E_YLOC75A4Sdaot1_H29lNWUlQmBlQV5hUqTS1F0cN-LBNgG9NStWWKleW_DV_eiSr76amTSQc2lBVQoMCQypUqGbnk-7Y2r0cnM0EovFT-G0lBcLub)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAIoWS0uPPNDYmh4qGvKoVscbU8TlQGdrmzLPqYeht49bY-_q3tpLIkWLQAgbse1Qci5H2mZ9XidKN4x6TgmlALCA27rgmn_cKe8wYyKDLZrhGtDQ7MIqLRGmJGkUUgBTTy0pjq063w)
- **Warning signs of bleeding:** Seek immediate medical care if you notice black or tarry stools, blood in your stool, or vomit that looks like blood or coffee grounds.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXX-9n_AuvfQEgcjPTZce7leJ8gXuYIIrIFLYoDaNBuoeCSIEhjmhWjlBiZQy8GA1qHJ3pGM8o0gYeE2hkhdVionpdIyIMhMWM_iPTBfA2lHCbQbGu4dqgVlls_dygQ4rQ827aSWEOTpHVd9A)

### Practical Precautions

- **Limit alcohol:** If a doctor approves alcohol while you take aspirin, keep intake low—generally no more than 1 drink per day for women and men over 65, and up to 2 drinks per day for men under 65. Avoid heavy or binge drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAIoWS0uPPNDYmh4qGvKoVscbU8TlQGdrmzLPqYeht49bY-_q3tpLIkWLQAgbse1Qci5H2mZ9XidKN4x6TgmlALCA27rgmn_cKe8wYyKDLZrhGtDQ7MIqLRGmJGkUUgBTTy0pjq063w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXd1fyr644D-gW6x5BgFe8rxHT_OQukA1fRiLUkajcasB2bwb9SMYS1uG6DqGs13h7huKYlVycrFSsip-Ynyw8vEgaVA9kdmgwHP8AgbfIgv7f429xCwEg4PI4vyiimvIu_ksM8H2rcULqaj6eU1kf7kELiIWqhj8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXXuhuEYtq7a-de2V1-rwqrvWcSWG744hJI96cjyR9FIYFvhVUDxTfNPsEubLi5x-Bt6_bL0IdBb38cNfUiiQxhCSRLKlTjAej6VBy3rBbW9Voko7Eec-3FAaJIA7J09VVr4i8rrMkA39Bp0epgiw)
- **Space them out:** Avoid taking aspirin immediately before, during, or right after drinking. For more details on timing and side effects, see [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAIoWS0uPPNDYmh4qGvKoVscbU8TlQGdrmzLPqYeht49bY-_q3tpLIkWLQAgbse1Qci5H2mZ9XidKN4x6TgmlALCA27rgmn_cKe8wYyKDLZrhGtDQ7MIqLRGmJGkUUgBTTy0pjq063w).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXhn6zq4ivRsGWIPLJ8DX32FqyGitx6YKfNnBcJBs-kdfbI6MRwro0JP2qwtVOBL-eb3jS4oXWzVc09GMApw9to3_pcc5RO0Pq_xWnBipqsQi-5_FcOGjsdz2tkj1cDNqijVvg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXd1fyr644D-gW6x5BgFe8rxHT_OQukA1fRiLUkajcasB2bwb9SMYS1uG6DqGs13h7huKYlVycrFSsip-Ynyw8vEgaVA9kdmgwHP8AgbfIgv7f429xCwEg4PI4vyiimvIu_ksM8H2rcULqaj6eU1kf7kELiIWqhj8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXAIoWS0uPPNDYmh4qGvKoVscbU8TlQGdrmzLPqYeht49bY-_q3tpLIkWLQAgbse1Qci5H2mZ9XidKN4x6TgmlALCA27rgmn_cKe8wYyKDLZrhGtDQ7MIqLRGmJGkUUgBTTy0pjq063w)
- **Check with a clinician:** Ask a doctor or pharmacist before combining them if you take daily low-dose aspirin, use blood thinners or other NSAIDs, or have a history of ulcers or liver issues.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXX9vn48dyhhv21NJ76at8N_pqe1ZdP6vR8pmyWHj2IteCfV-hSGdC5j3kyez6TzHx07amdaZDcHogIJ5jzPkKg0fMjJf1cTcwGgqkGdOAbU3eG5b42pkQ6lnV0p5o)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXhn6zq4ivRsGWIPLJ8DX32FqyGitx6YKfNnBcJBs-kdfbI6MRwro0JP2qwtVOBL-eb3jS4oXWzVc09GMApw9to3_pcc5RO0Pq_xWnBipqsQi-5_FcOGjsdz2tkj1cDNqijVvg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXtZOD9az4najZU-zgjgouqE71zgD3LUhTtMkI75-XXCbwEMxCzRPcy-uCC6jDLBERwUmL2gVZ86UA-tngQ61D6lcm-O3ia3k1uHI2lG_7OTQM01hx10YbaysIwYBRUgipqitPx_4nFA)
